title: Get a $5K+ Loan with a 550 FICO (Even After Being Turned Down)
actionable_recommendations: Consider applying to Oportun for loans between $300 and $10,000 if you have a thin credit profile.
Apply for NetCredit for loans ranging from $1,000 to over $10,000 depending on your FICO score.
Check out Upgrade for personal loans from $1,000 to $50,000, focusing on your income as a factor.
Seek loans from OneMain Financial which can offer between $1,500 and $20,000.
Look into LendingPoint for loans between $2,000 to $36,500 if your credit score is in the mid to high 600s.
Apply to Avant for loans of $2,000 to $35,000, especially if your credit score is in the mid 500s.
Join Navy Federal Credit Union for more lenient loan offerings, which may include unsecured credit cards up to $15,000.
